summary: Correct the self-confidence quotation from 78/98 to 78/97
rationale: The supplied Ritter 78/97 contains u zlamano, gud lowewa ... mhaymno b ruḥe, lo komičəkwa bi qamaytayḏan ... w ṭolabwa minan u medano, matching the glossary’s words and the sheikh’s explanation of the man’s confidence. Cited 78/98 instead contains the subsequent proposal to give him what he wants and withdraw without fighting.

summary: The inherited b-ruḥe self-confidence example belongs to I.2.
rationale: Its confidence enables standing before the court and demanding something; religious devotion is not asserted.

summary: New sense 2: (mit b-ruḥo) auf sich selbst vertrauen, seiner Sache sicher sein

data.gloss: (mit b-ruḥo) auf sich selbst vertrauen, seiner Sache sicher sein

rationale: 78/97 and 78/101 describe the confidence enabling a demand, rather than religious belief. The entry already quotes this construction but lacks a matching numbered sense.

summary: New sense 3: (mit l-) jemandem glauben, jemandem vertrauen
rationale: An explicit human l-target, l kulle ay yoḏuʕayḏe, contrasts with b-marked objects of faith and d-propositions. One clear attestation; numbered after round-1 I.2.

data.turoyo: <...> Ŭ i+ʕìtoste ṭábiki otomatík i+naqqayo híyaste k̬ʕəmro. Bəṯr məd mtalmḏi, məd mhaymanne.
data.translation: <...> And naturally, the church is automatically built at the same time, too. After they discipled, after they believed.

data.turoyo: Ŭ azzə́n, edi twərre aṣ+ṣalmaṯṯe ŭ mət̬haymanne, mət̬haymanne bә Mšiḥo ŭ hawən səryoye. <...>

data.translation: <...> He wrote letters to the different parts of his kingdom saying that everyone who believes in Jesus should be killed, he should be killed.

rationale: Thin Infectum I.1 cell; clear b-marked target in a generic relative construction.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Talay 1/101)

data.turoyo: Omər: "I naqla d diḏan, bnoṯe me diḏan, moṭən lann abnaṯxu, hat kombarxətte?" Omanno: "I naqla d mhaymni b Mšiḥo, gəmbaraxnanne." Omər: "Qay lə gəmhaymnina b Mšiḥo?"
data.translation: Er fragte: „Wenn unsere, Mädchen von uns, eure Söhne heiraten wollen, wirst du sie kirchlich trauen?“ Ich sagte: „Wenn sie an Christus glauben, dann werde ich sie trauen.“ Er sagte: „Glauben wir etwa nicht an Christus?“

rationale: Thin Infectum I.1 cell; a conditional third-person form and first-person plural response contrast within one source passage.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Talay 1/102)

data.turoyo: <...> i naqla hayo d əṯyo w məṭyo l zlam me diḏan, l abro me diḏan, d mhaymno b Mšiḥo w ʕəmḏo, maʕmaḏna, gəmbaraxna. <...>
data.translation: <...> Wenn ein (muslimisches) Mädchen einen unserer Männer, einen unserer Söhne heiraten will und den Glauben an Christus annimmt und sich taufen lässt, dann werde ich es auch trauen. <...>

rationale: Fifth Infectum I.1 example; feminine mhaymno in a finite condition is distinct from identical-looking masculine Part act.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Mor Barsaumo/15)

data.turoyo: <...> Komt̬ʰaymanno, b Aloho, d̥kətyo hano qadišo rabo <...>
data.translation: <...> I believe, by God, that he is a great saint <...>

rationale: Unusual first-person singular t-bearing Infectum with a content clause; keep the edition's by God without deciding its construction from translation alone.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Mor Barsaumo/36)

data.turoyo: <...> Uʕdo ṭolabno mu+alohayḏi doṯe maṭro aʕlayxu. Lo+kәmt̬haymnutu ebe? <...>
data.translation: <...> Now I’ll ask my God for rain to fall (lit. ‘come’) upon you. Don’t you believe in him? <...>

rationale: Unusual second-person plural t-bearing Infectum with pronominal b-target; supplied source establishes the experiencers and God antecedent.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (Lahdo martyrdom/15)

data.turoyo: <...> Mərle abro, itux hayman baṣ ṣalme w ono gmaḥənnolox, gdobenox dahwo, semo w gmaḥənnolox b rax diḏi waziro b iḏi di raste. Hat kfar bu hnano.
data.translation: <...> So he said: Son, come here and start worshipping the statues and I will give you gold and silver and I will appoint you a minister beside me; you will become my right hand, only if you deny this (Jesus).

rationale: Thin Imperativ I.1 cell; an actual command to believe in statues, rather than the assurance formula already quoted.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (MAC Hanna Dewo/132)

data.turoyo: <...> Haymén dlowe bu+qyoso ŭ bi+šehəl, lə+gmaqəblina!’
data.translation: <...> I swear if it is not with a weight and a scane, we won’t accept it!’

rationale: Thin Imperativ I.1 cell; English assurance with a conditional threat, preserving the edition's I swear.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (60/298)

data.turoyo: Komər ḥa yawmo may yawme d aloho məlle: “Ḥurma, haymen, quro yo aʕle, lazəm d ʕobər li oda d kətna aḥna, gmaḥtina parda bayn elan w ele.”
data.translation: Eines Tages von den Tagen Gottes sprach er: „Frau, er friert gewiß; er muß in das Zimmer hereinkommen, in dem wir wohnen. Wir bringen einen Vorhang zwischen ihm und uns an.“

rationale: Thin Imperativ I.1 cell; assurance to a feminine addressee gives evidence on invariance of haymen.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (62/71)
rationale: Fifth Imperativ I.1 example; short denial with overt assurance counterpart in German.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part act. (12/11)

data.turoyo: Šubḥan li ʕadaṯe bi ʕitayḏan bu yawmo du Rəššayš u kuhno kmoyəd parrat yaroqe d ilono — bəlxaṣṣa du gawzo — w kġaṭṭe bam maye qadiše w bi ʕito kroyəṣ ʕal a mhayəmne.
data.translation: Entsprechend diesem brauch nimmt in unserer Kirche am Pfingsttage der Priester grüne Baumzweige, - besonders solche vom Wallnußbaum, - taucht sie in heiliges Wasser und sprengt es in der Kirche auf die gläubigen.

rationale: Part act. I.1 cell falls to three after the self-confidence correction; add the plural substantivized faithful, absent from inherited singular examples.

data.turoyo: kətwo bu waxt d meqəm ṭabi, zlam mhayməno ġalabe. musakwo i Ndaṯalo, a tloṯo yawme di Ndaṯalo, du ʕeḏo di Ndaṯalo. <...>
data.translation: Es gab, in früherer Zeit natürlich, einen sehr gläubigen Mann. Er hielt fest an der Muttergottes, den drei Tagen der Muttergottes, dem Fest der Muttergottes. <...>

rationale: Fifth religious Part act. I.1 example after the move; concrete devotional context clarifies the enduring state.

rationale: Unusual plural mhaymenu beyond bare singular haymən; not mere thin-cell filling. Negation scopes over the report, not the quoted Imperativ. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

summary: New idiom: haymən 'glaube mir!, wahrlich!, sei versichert!'

data.turoyo: Məlle: “Haymen! U zʕurawo, d kətwo gabayna u pisawo, hawo, d ʕoyaqwaylax mine, aḥuni Skandar yo.
data.translation: Er sprach: "Glaube mir, jener häßliche Jüngling, der bei uns war, jener, den du sogar nicht ausstehen konntest, ist mein Bruder Skändär.

rationale: Bare assurance is repeatedly attested without b-aloho; permitted haymən lookup finds only the inherited oath and Imperativ example. Record as a discourse collocation, not a new belief sense.

summary: 70 supplied occurrence records comprise 68 full verses and two compact records (43/5, 61/67). The latter cannot be rechecked against unavailable verses; neither is quoted.

Belief experiencers are unmarked human subjects; targets of faith take b- (Christ, God, statues, the spotted calf), while d- introduces propositional content. No additional lexical worship sense is inferred from English start worshipping.
Preterit conversion contrasts with standing devotion in Part act. and generic or conditional belief in Infectum. Feminine finite mhaymno in Talay 1/102 must not be confused with masculine Part act.

t-bearing məthaymalle, mət̬haymanne, komt̬ʰaymanno and kәmt̬haymnutu have believing experiencers and active meanings. The entry already has the variant məthaymən and the Mor Barsaumo/14 quotation under Idiomatic phrases; no Detransitive paradigm or separate stem is manufactured.

Bare haymən confirms a proposition, sometimes to female or plural addressees or in self-directed discourse. It can be translated wahrlich, wirklich, surely, I swear or not separately at all. These are contextual realizations of the assurance formula, not six new senses.
The PrS 72/31 mercy reading cannot be separated from neighbouring hay daxil on German Gnade alone; merge with assurance and ask about interjection status.

The PrS 56/4 spotted-calf clause duplicates the inherited Infectum-wa example cited prs 151/36; the difference may reflect edition or numbering systems, so retain the inherited reference and request reconciliation.

All exact inherited citations, the Mor Barsaumo/14 idiom, the LB 94/Talay 1/94 passage, and repeated mət̬haymanne in one verse are kept from inflating example counts. The sole inherited Imperativ already lists several supporting references without their full text.
Round 2 only. Jan English is a project machine translation; semantic decisions are based on the Turoyo. Round-1 proposals remain prior material and are not re-proposed here.
Retain the glossary stem I for hymn, including m-prefixed forms; no reclassification from surface shape. L-marked human stimulus at 3.17/325 warrants I.3; the experiencer remains unmarked.

Conversion mhaymanle co-occurs with hawi dayroyo (2.15/3471); nominal mhayəmne and predicative mhayəmno express standing devotion (2.13/3301; 2.32/5284). These support prior aspect distinctions without extra examples.
The numerous Haymən tokens support the assurance formula already proposed in round 1. No independent idiom is established by samyo b samyo, a manner phrase in reported advice.
Məthaymən, klozəm d umarno (4.I/584) and Məthaymən u xabro (4.I/606) supply evidence for the existing formula; their machine-translated certainly cannot prove impersonal voice.
Supply the omitted source verses for compact records 43/5 mhaymanto and 61/67 Haymen. Their analyses remain provisional and have not generated quotations.

Does the t-bearing məthaymən family constitute an active dialect variant, a historically Detransitive form with lexical active meaning, or a distinct paradigm? Resolve before creating a Detransitive section.
At Mor Barsaumo/15 does b Aloho mark the faith target or an oath alongside the following d-clause? The edition's by God is retained without using it as sole analysis.
Is bare haymən invariant across gender and number, as female address at 60/298 and collective address at 61/19 and 64/205 suggest?
At PrS 72/31 is haymen an Imperativ-based assurance or an independent appeal? Can mercy/please be attributed to it independently of hay daxil?
Verify scope of lo in MAC Hanna Dewo/236 and 62/267; neither English not really nor German Nicht doch proves a negative Imperativ.
101/28 has an alignment flag and lacks German for Haymən gəzzinole. Verify that missing clause; no flagged German has been quoted.
Reconcile inherited prs 151/36 with supplied PrS 56/4 for the spotted-calf example without silently replacing one numbering system with another.
Resolve the paradigm and discourse force of məthaymən across Jan 2.35/5522–5523 and 4.I/584, /606; the latter are not accepted as Detransitive solely on the reader label.
At Jan 4.I/230 is mhaymno bu ʕwodayḏe confidence in work, loyalty to it or conscientiousness? The supplied sentence is incomplete.
Verify yomənwa b qarʕe at Jan 4.I/310 and its root before including it under hymn.
Clarify negation scope in Lo haymen lo (2.21/3905).

Jan supports round-1 assurance haymən across interview recollection, including repeated Haymən ... haymən. məthaymən likewise introduces appeals or qualifications; certainty alone does not establish a new Detransitive sense.
Ordinary belief extends to a political assessment, an identification and a cause, with an unintroduced proposition, d-clause or b- respectively. Existing glauben covers these without new senses.
